Transformer Manufacturers

A growing, sourced directory of transformer makers — power, distribution and dry-type/cast-resin — listed country by country, with locations and official links. Coverage expands as public records are confirmed; this is not every workshop worldwide.

Company pages lead with the place, products and sourced figures already on that record. A year of establishment is printed only when the census already has one. Listings are compiled from public sources. Verification confirms company identity and published profile data. It does not constitute technical certification, factory approval or commercial endorsement.

Searchable sourcing directory → filter by transformer type, voltage, country and capability evidence, then compare and RFQ. No ranking.
